bio: Charles Carter Robbins, whose surname is also written Robins, was born on 30 September 1829 in Greenwich Township, Gloucester County, New Jersey, according to family records, the son of John Robbins (1803–1886) and Sarah Carter (1800–1886). He married Keturah Pringle, and their children were Emily (1855–1930), Ella (1859–1919), Lulu M. (1862–1950), Byron S. (1870–1951) and Clarence Howard (1873–1959). He died on 23 September 1878 in Hanover Township, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, and was buried in Hanover Cemetery. His daughter Lulu married Charles W. Honeywell, the Plymouth tax collector, on 28 February 1883, and his widow Keturah married Philip Manhart on 19 September 1883.
